items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: If Johnny or Barney or any of them were in an argument, wasn't playing the music right, I'd holler at them.

ctx.x: Yeah. If Johnny or Barney or any of them were in an argument, wasn't playing the music right, I'd holler at them. Because Duke would never say nothing to them. I'd be the one that had taken over that spot.

Hodges was with Chick Webb. Cootie was with Chick Webb. Cootie came after me. Hodges came after me. That's about all. But it wasn't long after. Tizol, I think, came in after me, not long. They sent for him from Washington. And Whetsql, Art Whetsql.
Had Duke known them in Washington or --
